user.title: SEPTA Transit
user.description: Pick the station to track, then turn on only the services you use. Suburban stations like Lansdale typically want Regional Rail and buses — leave Metro and trolley off.

data.ride_tracker: Phone tracker (which train am I on)
data.ride_riders: People and phones on the train
data.ride_matches: Fixes in a row before boarding
data.ride_request_updates: Ask the phone for a fresh location near a station

abort.already_configured: That station and destination are already configured.

error.invalid_station: Pick a Regional Rail station. Metro and trolley stops belong on their own lists.

init.title: SEPTA Transit options
init.description: Turn services on or off. Disabled services are not fetched and their sensors are removed. The phone tracker is optional and only used to detect which train you are on.

data.ride_tracker: Phone tracker (which train am I on)
data.ride_riders: People and phones on the train
data.ride_matches: Fixes in a row before boarding
data.ride_request_updates: Ask the phone for a fresh location near a station
data.configure_dynamic: Set up Going Home and day trains

dynamic.title: Dynamic trips
dynamic.description: Home is where Going Home ends and where day trains start. The city station is the fallback origin when nobody is near a station. The calendar here is the default for every rider.

data.event_lookahead_h: Look ahead for the next event (hours)
data.event_walk_speed: Walk from the station to the event (meters per minute)
data.max_trains: Max trains to keep on the sensor
data.geocode: Geocode calendar locations (optional, sends the location text to Nominatim)

rider.title: Rider {rider}
rider.description: Leave a field blank to use the shared home, city station, and calendar.

error.invalid_station: Pick a Regional Rail station. Metro and trolley stops belong on their own lists.

refresh_trips.name: Refresh trips
refresh_trips.description: Fetch NextToArrive again for configured trips.

set_expected_train.name: Set expected train
set_expected_train.description: Prefer this train while matching a ride. A blank train clears the hint.

simulate_ride.name: Simulate a ride
simulate_ride.description: Replay phone fixes without changing the live riding sensor.

set_origin_station.name: Set origin station
set_origin_station.description: Hold a Going Home origin. A blank station returns to automatic.

set_destination.name: Set destination
set_destination.description: Hold the day-trains destination. A blank station clears it.

refresh_schedule.name: Refresh rail schedule
refresh_schedule.description: Download SEPTA's Regional Rail timetable. Leave force off to skip a timetable that is still current.

plan_trips.name: Plan trips
plan_trips.description: List trains from one station to another after a time, or arriving by a time. Does not change a rider's Going Home origin.

rail_schedule_stale.title: Regional Rail timetable is out of date
rail_schedule_stale.description: SEPTA Live could not refresh the Regional Rail timetable and the one in use is expired or about to expire. Trains keep updating. The timetable will be replaced on the next successful refresh.

rail_station_legacy.title: Saved station is not Regional Rail
rail_station_legacy.description: {station} is not a Regional Rail station, so it was left as saved. Open SEPTA options and pick a station from the Regional Rail list.

unknown_station.message: {station} is not a Regional Rail station.
